scope: Input proposal for root's scheduled QBE controls; not executed evidence. Compare independent Phase106 reference plus C/Cranelift, and check every output with the common runner.

classify.purpose: Unsigned comparisons and full-width character classification

shift.purpose: Modulo32 shift counts and logical right shift

qbe_ptr_offset.oracle: 1 if n==4294967295 else 3; pointer bits only, no memory dereference

qbe_cap512.oracle: (seed+127) mod 2^32; raw body exactly512 nodes, admitted for entry fusion

qbe_cap516.oracle: (seed+128) mod 2^32; raw body516 nodes, must fall back to call wrapper

qbe_entry_pointer.oracle: (seed+n) mod 2^32; recursive entry through its ordinary function pointer

extraControlsWorthAdding: seven or more arguments crossing the SysV integer-register argument limit
wrong runner --expect must fail even with two repeated outputs whose checksums collide
rejections: wrong direct argument/result type or arity
wrong explicit indirect argument type or arity
statement after unconditional return or function without complete return
unknown operator/type/function and unsupported source/GPU/parallel constructs
